pdb_path.description: Absolute path to a complex PDB structure (≥2 chains) PRODIGY will analyze for binding affinity via contact-count regression.

candidates.$comment: Canonical Candidate v1 input accepted additively; see src/vibeproteinagent/schemas/candidate_v1.json.
candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream complex-prediction tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `pdb_path` when omitted.

chain_a.description: Chain id (or comma-separated list) for the first binding partner (e.g. the target receptor).

chain_b.description: Chain id (or comma-separated list) for the second binding partner (e.g. the designed binder).

temperature_k.description: Temperature in Kelvin used by PRODIGY's ΔG-to-Kd conversion. Default 298.15 K (~25 °C); set to 310.15 K for physiological conditions.
